SELECT 
    df."RecordRegistry" as flow_id,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (rm."risk_management_profile"->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric / 100.0 * 
        (1.0 / NULLIF((rm."risk_management_profile"->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric / 100.0, 0))
    AS numeric), 4) as risk_exposure,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / 100.0 * 
        (1.0 - (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric / ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1.0))
    AS numeric), 4) as reliability_score
FROM "DataFlow" df
JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON df."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign"
JOIN "RiskManagement" rm ON dp."riskJoin" = rm."RISKTRACE"
WHERE rm."risk_management_profile"->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct' != 'None'
  AND (rm."risk_management_profile"->'assessment'->>'risk_score')::numeric / 100.0 * (1.0 / NULLIF((rm."risk_management_profile"->'assessment'->>'control_effectiveness_pct')::numeric / 100.0, 0)) > 0.7
  AND (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / 100.0 * (1.0 - (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric / ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1.0)) < 0.5;

SELECT 
    df."RecordRegistry",
    (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / 100.0 as success_rate,
    (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric as retry_count,
    (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric as error_count,
    -- DTE = success_rate / (error_count + 1)
    ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / 100.0) / ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1.0) as dte,
    -- DFRS using DTE as transfer efficiency
    ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'success_pct')::numeric / 100.0) / ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1.0) * (1.0 - (df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'retry_count')::numeric / ((df."flow_overview"->'performance'->>'error_count')::numeric + 1.0)) as dfrs_dte
FROM "DataFlow" df
LIMIT 10;
